import HartshorneLib.Chapter4GlobalResidueExact
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4LogarithmicResidueTheorem
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ResidueFiniteSum

/-!
# The global residue functional

Finite support of the intrinsic point residues lets us sum them pointwise and
package the result as a `k`-linear functional.  This is the scalar trace
precursor used by the cohomological residue construction; its vanishing on
regular differentials is proved directly from the local regular-vanishing
theorem.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom]

/-- Sum all point residues of a rational differential. -/
def globalCurveResidue : CurveRationalDifferentials X →ₗ[k] k where
  toFun := fun ω => ∑ᶠ p : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left},
    curveRationalDifferentialResidue X p.2 ω
  map_add' := by
    intro ω η
    simpa only [map_add] using finsum_add_distrib
      (curveRationalDifferentialResidue_support_finite X ω)
      (curveRationalDifferentialResidue_support_finite X η)
  map_smul' := by
    intro r ω
    calc
      _ = ∑ᶠ p : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left},
          r • curveRationalDifferentialResidue X p.2 ω := by
        apply finsum_congr
        intro p
        simp only [map_smul]
      _ = r • ∑ᶠ p : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left},
          curveRationalDifferentialResidue X p.2 ω :=
        (smul_finsum' r (curveRationalDifferentialResidue_support_finite X ω)).symm

@[simp]
theorem globalCurveResidue_apply (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :
    globalCurveResidue X ω =
      ∑ᶠ p : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left},
        curveRationalDifferentialResidue X p.2 ω := rfl

/-- A differential regular at every closed point has zero global residue. -/
theorem globalCurveResidue_eq_zero_of_everywhere_regular
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X)
    (hω : ∀ p : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left},
      ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X p.1) :
    globalCurveResidue X ω = 0 := by
  rw [globalCurveResidue_apply]
  calc
    _ = ∑ᶠ p : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left}, 0 :=
      finsum_congr fun p => curveRationalDifferentialResidue_eq_zero_of_regular X p.2 (hω p)
    _ = 0 := finsum_zero

/-- Exact rational differentials have zero global residue. -/
theorem globalCurveResidue_differential_eq_zero (f : X.left.functionField) :
    globalCurveResidue X (KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField f) = 0 := by
  rw [globalCurveResidue_apply]
  exact finsum_curveRationalDifferentialResidue_differential_eq_zero X f

variable [IsProper X.hom]

/-- Logarithmic differentials lie in the kernel of the global residue
functional.  This is the functional-level form of the finite logarithmic
residue theorem and is the compatibility needed by the later scalar trace
construction. -/
theorem globalCurveResidue_log_eq_zero (g : X.left.functionFieldˣ) :
    globalCurveResidue X (curveLogDifferential X g) = 0 := by
  rw [globalCurveResidue_apply]
  exact finsum_curveRationalDifferentialResidue_log_eq_zero X g

end
end Hartshorne
